name: voicevox
description: Run /voicevox on to hear each reply read aloud by a local VOICEVOX engine, sentence by sentence as it is written (or, with plamo on, as PLaMo translates it); /voicevox speaker lists and switches the voice

url.title: VOICEVOX engine URL
url.description: Base URL of the VOICEVOX engine (uses /audio_query and /synthesis, tested with engine 0.26.1; needs curl)

speaker.title: Default speaker ID
speaker.description: Style ID used until /voicevox speaker picks another; 3 is Zundamon (normal)

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Speaking speed (VOICEVOX speedScale): 1.0 is normal, larger is faster, e.g. 1.3

playCommand.title: Play command
playCommand.description: Command that plays a WAV from stdin, e.g. paplay or pw-play -

startCommand.title: Start command
startCommand.description: Run with bash -c when the engine does not answer on /voicevox on; $1 is the port. Empty: never start
